European patent covers TNBC treatment and diagnosis

China patent covers TNBC and other aggressive cancers
Extends protection to a major market and additional cancer indications, including lung and pancreatic cancer.
Second US patent covers CNS tumour detection
Expands the patent family to diagnostic methods for glioma and glioblastoma; no revenue impact was disclosed.
Patents extend to 2040 in Europe and China
Provides long-dated protection, though the release gives no financial terms or commercialization timeline.
US patent is in force until September 2037
